name: dropflow
description: Browser-based local network file sharing over WebRTC

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.build: npm run build -w server && npm run build -w client
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w client && tsc -p tsconfig.e2e.json
scripts.dev:https: concurrently -n server,client -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev:https -w client"
